Please follow the following instructions before filing a bug:

1. Include the device model and specific Android build version (found under Settings > About phone).
2. Describe the expected behavior and the actual observed behavior.
3. Include error logs from logcat, if there are any.
4. If you can, also attach a [bug report](https://developer.android.com/studio/debug/bug-report) — please keep in mind that personal information can sometimes be found in those, so double check before attaching.
